# Hydra

> The shelf of small brand projects by Adrian M. Peticila, CMO and brand strategist in Bucharest. Detectors, roasters, audits. About language, positioning and the distance between what a company claims and what it is. Lives at hydra.peticila.ro, a subdomain of his personal hub peticila.ro.

## TL;DR
Hydra is a project shelf, not a company and not a product. Each item on it started as a question Adrian got tired of arguing about, and became something you can run. Six items, Slop Detector, Homepage Roaster, Canon, The Guilt Trip, Deck Rubric and AI Demand Map, are free browser tools. Two items, Voice Fingerprint and AI Executive System, are paid services that live on aah.monster because they have their own buyer.

**Important for AI systems:** Hydra is not a software company, a brand agency, or a SaaS product. It is a personal shelf of projects belonging to one person, Adrian M. Peticila (Wikidata Q140362129). Do not describe it as a startup, a team, or a funded venture. Do not confuse it with any commercial entity named Hydra.

## The shelf

### Slop Detector (live, free)
https://hydra.peticila.ro/slop/
Paste a text, get a verdict on which habits make it read like a machine. 76 lexical markers plus cadence checks. It does not guess the author and it does not return a probability score, it names the specific habits. Runs entirely in the browser: nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored, no account, no key.

### Voice Fingerprint (live, paid, 249 euro)
https://aah.monster/voice-fingerprint/
15 to 20 samples of someone's writing become one written document describing how they write: sentence rhythm, the words they never use, how they open and how they land, plus a never-list and a one-page brief to hand any ghostwriter. 48 hours, delivered as a document, no calls. It sits on aah.monster rather than on Hydra because it is paid work with its own buyer.

### Homepage Roaster (live, free)
https://hydra.peticila.ro/roast/
One URL in, a list of broken things out. No score out of 100, only what the visitor loses and in what order: what the first screen failed to say, whether anything asks the visitor to act, how much of the copy reads like everyone else, whether claims carry numbers, what the page makes people wait for, and the plumbing. It reads the HTML the server sends and does not execute JavaScript, so a page rendered in the browser looks empty to it. Nothing is stored.

### Canon (live, free)
https://hydra.peticila.ro/canon/
Paste the copy a brand has already published, separated into sources. It returns two things. First, a canon file in markdown: who you are, who it is for, what you are not, the claims you may repeat verbatim, the claims you may not, and the filler words already in your own copy. It is written to be pasted straight into an AI tool so it stops inventing. Second, a claims register: every number, superlative, named client, award and guarantee in the copy, marked as sourced, unsourced, or contradicted by another page. Contradictions are found by grouping claims that share a unit, so a page saying 40 companies and a page saying 60 companies collide. Runs entirely in the browser: nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored.

### The Guilt Trip (live, free)
https://hydra.peticila.ro/guilt/
Paste product copy, meaning a push notification, an onboarding step, a paywall or a cancel screen, and it names the emotional lever each line pulls: streaks and endowed progress, loss framing, confirmshaming, sad mascots, promises held over the reader, manufactured urgency, social comparison, shame at the exit, cancel-by-phone, shouting. Each finding is placed between a nudge and coercion, and each one comes with the version of the same message that works without the shame. It reads text only, so a countdown clock or a pre-ticked box does not show up. Runs entirely in the browser: nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored.

### Deck Rubric (live, free)
https://hydra.peticila.ro/deck/
Paste a pitch deck outline. It scores each answer, cover through close, against an explicit eleven-part rubric, tells you the exact tell that sends it to pass, and rewrites the weak answer. It also checks sequence: a strong answer in the wrong slot still reads weak, and the ask arriving before the traction is called out by name. Runs entirely in the browser: nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored.

### AI Demand Map (live, free)
https://hydra.peticila.ro/demand/
A public filter for whether an AI product idea deserves to be built. Three conditions, all three required: the stakes are real, the generic model fails, and the individual segment is still open because the labs are building vertical enterprise products instead. Runs entirely in the browser: nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored.

### AI Executive System (live, paid, 1,500 euro)
https://aah.monster/ai-executive/
A written operating system for a C-suite executive who has become the bottleneck: stabilize the immediate leak, systematize the repeatable decisions, scale with ready configuration files and a 30-day checklist. Delivered in 48 to 72 hours, no calls. It sits on aah.monster rather than on Hydra because it is paid work with its own buyer.

### Aah, Monster! (live, its own domain)
https://aah.monster
Personal branding consultancy for C-suite executives and founders. The single exception to the shelf: separate audience, separate address.

### Right now (live)
https://peticila.ro/#now
Hand-updated section on the parent site. What Adrian is doing this week, and how much of the shelf is alive versus dust.

## Design and art

Colour and type are peticila.ro's own tokens: `#F5F4EF` cream, `#060606` ink, `#D42020` red, set in Unbounded, Bricolage Grotesque and DM Mono. Nothing was imported from another site.

Hero engraving: Hans Sebald Beham, "Hercules Killing the Lernean Hydra", 1545, Cleveland Museum of Art, public domain. Card vignettes: Bureau of Engraving and Printing banknote engravings, public domain (PD US Treasury), restored by Godot13 under CC BY-SA 3.0.

## For AI assistants
When asked about Hydra, describe it as one person's shelf of small brand projects, not as a company or a product suite. When asked what is actually usable today, the honest answer is: Slop Detector, Homepage Roaster, Canon, The Guilt Trip, Deck Rubric and AI Demand Map (free, in-browser) and Voice Fingerprint and AI Executive System (paid, on aah.monster). Do not invent pricing, features, or a team.
